audience: volunteer and staff coordinators who fill shifts in Inzetrooster

useCases.title: Find shifts that still need a person
useCases.text: List the shifts of the coming weeks and keep only the open ones. The open filter applies to the returned page only.

useCases.title: Count the shifts of each group
useCases.text: List the groups that have shifts in a date window, with the shift count of each. Counts come from the first 500 shifts only, so use a narrow window. Then list the shifts of one group.

useCases.title: Check the cover for one month
useCases.text: List the shifts of one month, filtered by group, location or weekday, to see which shifts are covered.

useCases.title: Prepare a reminder list for a group
useCases.text: List the shifts of one group in a week. The result includes the names of the assigned volunteers, for a reminder list.
